title: "create_new_links"

output: html_document
---

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r read template}
links_template <- paste(readLines("./data/input/links_template.txt"), collapse = "\n")
```

```{r read GRIIS checklist}
griis_checklist_raw <- read_tsv("./data/output/UAT_processing/data_input_checklist_indicators.tsv")
```

```{r prep griis checklist}
griis_checklist <- griis_checklist_raw %>% 
  filter(!is.na(nubKey)) %>% 
  select(nubKey, scientificName = canonicalName, vernacular_name_nl, vernacular_name_en, vernacular_name_fr) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  separate(vernacular_name_nl, sep = ", ", into = "vernacular_name_nl", extra = "drop") %>% 
  separate(vernacular_name_en, sep = ", ", into = "vernacular_name_en", extra = "drop") %>%
  separate(vernacular_name_fr, sep = ", ", into = "vernacular_name_fr", extra = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(vernacular_name_nl = str_replace_na(vernacular_name_nl, ""),
         vernacular_name_en = str_replace_na(vernacular_name_en, ""),
         vernacular_name_fr = str_replace_na(vernacular_name_fr, ""))
```

```{r create link files}
for(i in 1:nrow(griis_checklist)){
  
  # get the current row
  current_row <- griis_checklist[i, ]
  
  # create filename
  filename <- paste0("./HTML_pages/Rmd_files/", current_row$nubKey, ".Rmd")
  
  # check if the file for the current row already exists
  if(file.exists(filename)){
    next
  }
  
  # replace the placeholders in the template with actual values
  new_link <- links_template %>% 
    gsub(pattern = "<--TAXONKEY-->", 
         replacement = as.character(current_row$nubKey), 
         x = .) %>% 
    gsub(pattern = "<--SCIENTIFICNAME-->",
         replacement = current_row$scientificName, 
         x = .) %>% 
    gsub(pattern = "<--VERNACULAR_NAME_NL-->",
         replacement = current_row$vernacular_name_nl, 
         x = .) %>%
    gsub(pattern = "<--VERNACULAR_NAME_EN-->",
         replacement = current_row$vernacular_name_en, 
         x = .) %>%
    gsub(pattern = "<--VERNACULAR_NAME_FR-->",
         replacement = current_row$vernacular_name_fr, 
         x = .) 

  # write the new link to a file
  writeLines(new_link, filename)
}
```
